author: Claude (codex seat, handoff 197)
status: FROZEN. Committed alone, before any exit-timing figure is computed and before any outcome under any rule below is inspected.
group: B19 — pre-execution design artifacts written before the thing they describe exists. B19a is the wallet/treasury architecture; B19b/c/d are the strategy preregistrations of slice D.
question: Does the CHOICE of exit coordinate change the executable outcome at all, beyond the two fixed horizons already frozen — and can that be measured without any threshold being tuned on an outcome?

why_this_is_written_now_rather_than_late.principle: a preregistration's entire epistemic value comes from being fixed BEFORE the evidence it will be judged against exists. Written after, the same document cannot honestly be written at all.
why_this_is_written_now_rather_than_late.the_hazard_this_does_not_escape: the burned corpus (B8b/B9/B10/B16) already exists today and will still exist later. Delay does not shrink that surface. It is handled by the disclosure block below and by the structural choices in `no_threshold_is_tunable_here`, not by waiting.
why_this_is_written_now_rather_than_late.recorded_by: handoff 197; the owner chose slice D over slice E with both agent seats recommending otherwise, and that disagreement is recorded rather than smoothed.

known_at_authorship_time.purpose: so a later reader can AUDIT the fit rather than trust an assurance that none occurred
known_at_authorship_time.b15l: of 14,688 priced cells the naive observed-book exit could be priced on only 2,748; on the rest the observed curve held on the order of one lamport of real quote. Known.
known_at_authorship_time.b15m: external-liquidity capacity was measured per cell with a search ceiling of 100000000 lamports. Known that the study ran; its capacity distribution is NOT used to place, order or motivate any rule below.
known_at_authorship_time.b16d: one non-issuance signal was priced on burned data and every priced variant was negative. Known.
known_at_authorship_time.b11: has NOT produced its result. No fresh-window composition or outcome has been read by this author, and none is referenced.
known_at_authorship_time.what_that_forbids: no rule below may be justified, ordered, added or dropped by appeal to any figure named above.

no_threshold_is_tunable_here.rule: every candidate rule is either PARAMETER-FREE, or inherited verbatim from an already-frozen document, or a member of a fixed grid reported in full with no member selected.
no_threshold_is_tunable_here.why_structural: a rule with a free numeric cut invites choosing the cut from the answer. Removing the free parameter removes the temptation mechanically rather than forbidding it in prose.
no_threshold_is_tunable_here.consequence_accepted: genuinely adaptive exit rules are therefore OUT OF SCOPE of this study, and that is a deliberate cost, not an oversight.

population.rule: the IDENTICAL admissible cell universe as B15M_LIQUIDITY_CAPACITY_V1, which is itself B15L's universe, by the same conditions in the same order
population.no_new_admission: this study admits no cell those refused and refuses none they admitted, except where a refusal code below names a condition specific to exit timing
population.development_vs_evaluation: runs against the burned corpus are DEVELOPMENT ONLY and may never be reported as an evaluation result. Evaluation, if it ever occurs, is on a window this author has not read.

frozen_inputs_unchanged.entry_delay_source: B15D_SHADOW_ROUTE_V1, inherited unchanged and not re-derived
frozen_inputs_unchanged.position_source: 0.1 SOL, fixed from B10a onward; no size is chosen, recommended or varied here
frozen_inputs_unchanged.arithmetic: B9I's pinned formulas and B10a's price_entry, price_exit and curve_fees by direct call. No formula is reimplemented. Every quantity is an exact Python integer and every fraction an exact rational pair. NO FLOAT ANYWHERE.
frozen_inputs_unchanged.canonical_order: (slot, transaction_index, outer_index, inner_index), never insertion order

frozen_exit_rules.note: the complete list. No rule may be added, removed or reparameterised after any outcome is seen.

set.definition: the incumbent fixed horizon h_1000_slots, B10c state-in-force semantics unchanged
the incumbent fixed horizon h_10000_slots, unchanged
the first canonical observation strictly after the entry coordinate
set.role: the earliest exit the evidence permits; a floor, not a proposal

set.definition: the earliest canonical observation at or after entry whose OBSERVED external reserves could pay for the full position in one sale, by B15M's external-only constraint with our own buy's reserve contribution NOT carried forward
set.role: this is the 'beyond B15m's gate' rule: B15m used external payability as an ADMISSIBILITY GATE at a fixed horizon; here the same predicate is a TIMING TRIGGER. Same arithmetic, different use, and the difference is the question.

set.definition: the curve's completion coordinate if completion occurs at or before h_10000_slots, else h_10000_slots
set.role: tests whether completion is a materially different exit instant from the horizon that contains it

set.parameters: exact rational 1/10, member of a fixed grid
set.definition: the first observation at which realizable external quote for the held position falls at or below (1 - 1/10) of its running peak since entry

set.parameters: exact rational 1/4, member of a fixed grid
exact rational 1/2, member of a fixed grid

frozen_exit_rules.grid_is_not_selection: the three drawdown fractions are reported in full, including any that fail. No fraction will be selected, ranked best, or described as optimal, and a reader choosing among them is doing something this study does not do.
frozen_exit_rules.grid_rationale: 1/10, 1/4 and 1/2 are exact halving-and-quartering landmarks spanning an order of magnitude, written down before any drawdown figure was computed. They are not derived from any observed distribution.

right_censoring.rule: if a rule's trigger condition is never satisfied within the cell's observed path, the cell is RIGHT-CENSORED under that rule and carries NO outcome
right_censoring.never_zero: a censored cell is never counted as zero, never imputed, and never dropped silently. Zero-by-absence is forbidden.
right_censoring.reported: the censored count is reported per rule, per delay, beside every figure, so no distribution can be read without the share of cells that produced no number

capacity_gate.rule: B15M's external-only payability is applied at the exit coordinate each rule selects; a cell whose exit the observed reserves could not pay for is REFUSED, never priced against liquidity our own entry supplied
capacity_gate.circular_liquidity_dependence: reported per rule, by B15M's definition, because an exit funded by one's own entry is not liquidity and left unnamed would read as a priced cell

denominator_and_coverage.reported_first: coverage — cells admitted, refused by code, and censored per rule — is reported BEFORE any outcome figure, so no outcome can be read without the share of the cohort it came from
denominator_and_coverage.whole_cohort: the admissible universe is the denominator; a rule that triggers on few cells is reported as triggering on few cells

outcome_reporting.statistics: exact integer order statistics by integer index into the sorted values: min, p10, p25, median, p75, p90, max, and counts at or below zero. NO MEAN, because a mean over a censored heavy-tailed set invites reading it as an expectation.
outcome_reporting.never_aggregated: no figure spans two rules, two delays or two cost scenarios. Alternative assumptions are not samples of a distribution.
outcome_reporting.tail_and_concentration: the share of total positive outcome attributable to the top cells is reported per rule, so a lottery shape cannot present as an edge
outcome_reporting.not_a_return: no figure is a return, a profit, an expected value or a performance result, and none may be described as one

multiplicity.members: 8 rules crossed with 3 delays, within a single cost scenario
multiplicity.primary_result: ONE pre-committed figure: the exact integer median net outcome per rule at delay 1 under the `base` cost scenario, reported beside its coverage and censored count. Every other cell is secondary, reported only in a table, and MAY NOT be promoted to primary after the fact.
multiplicity.correction_if_ever_tested: any future inferential claim over this family uses a Bonferroni-corrected alpha of 0.05/24 = 0.00208333...
multiplicity.no_test_in_this_pass: no significance test, confidence interval or p-value is computed. Grouped uncertainty, if reported, is an assumption-free jackknife range.

determinism.row_permutation: the output must be identical under any permutation of the input rows
determinism.checked: by running the whole computation over shuffled inputs and comparing field for field

refusal_codes.meaning: the cell is not admissible under B15L/B15M conditions
no observation exists at or after the delayed entry coordinate
the rule's condition is not satisfied within the observed path; the cell is right-censored under that rule
B10a refused the exit at the selected coordinate
the observed external reserves could not pay for the sale at the selected coordinate
the curve is complete at entry, so the observed state is not one our order could have traded against
the curve's fee basis points could not be decoded from its own TradeEvents
a non-integer appeared in a quantity
observations were not in canonical coordinate order

prohibitions: no rule may be added, removed or reparameterised after seeing any outcome
no exit rule may be SELECTED, ranked best, recommended or adopted on the strength of this study; adopting one requires a NEW preregistration committed before the choice
no threshold may be tuned from any outcome
no figure from the burned corpus may be reported as an evaluation result
no reading of research/b11a composition or outcomes; no network; no signing, submission, spend or transaction construction
no position size is chosen, varied or recommended
no claim about landing probability, which this study does not measure
no aggregation across rules, delays or cost scenarios
